b1-unit-31.31.1 Ana's new kitchen:
Danny: Hi Ana! Is this a good time? You sound busy.
Ana: Hi Danny! It's absolutely chaotic here. We're having the kitchen remodeled, so there are workers everywhere.
Danny: Wow! What are you having done?
Ana: Everything! We're having new cabinets installed, and next week we're having a new stove put in. Last month we found a leak under the sink, so we had the pipes checked by a plumber.
Danny: Did Marcos try to fix it himself?
Ana: Of course he did! He watched a video, bought a wrench and made it worse. The kitchen floor was completely wet. After that, we called a professional.
Danny: Ha! What about the lights?
Ana: The electrician is coming on Friday. Half the kitchen has no electricity, and Marcos says it's the fuse box. I don't trust him anymore!
Danny: And the walls?
Ana: We were going to have them painted, but it's really expensive. Maybe we'll do that ourselves.
Danny: I can help! I painted my room back home, and I've got the whole weekend free. Do you have rollers and brushes?
Ana: Marcos has a toolbox full of things he never uses. Are you sure?
Danny: Totally. You'll just have to feed me.
Ana: Deal! Pizza on Saturday and Grandma's chicken soup on Sunday.
